ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixel distribution (>200 on 8-bit scale) across central fluke regions against low-intensity black margins (<30) creating a sharp bimodal contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe contains a broad contiguous white region spanning the central 70% of the surface; left lobe exhibits a similar pattern but is approximately 30% occluded by high-frequency white water-spray pixels in the proximal region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks of approx. 15% of the horizontal fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary with high-amplitude (8-15 pixel) serrations occurring at a frequency of approximately 1 peak per 40 horizontal pixels on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep trajectory from the median notch convergence towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular clusters of light-grey and white pixels (>5px diameter) concentrated on the distal lateral tips and along the leading edge margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions observed on the central white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent structural notches and irregular tissue loss along the upper trailing margins of both lobes, combined with heavy parasitic colonization on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-intensity pixel noise (spray/splash) obscuring the lower-left ventral quadrant of the fluke assembly.
